title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.331 - Added `sideload_flags_disabled` to `startup_failure_reason`, for a start that managed `disableSideloadFlags` refuses over a flag or launch option - Added `processing_at` to `getCcrEvent()`, and fixed browser SDK `sse` queries dropping the server's queued notices - Fixed the browser SDK ignoring `Retry-After` when a session's event stream is refused - Fixed the Edit and Write tool results not reporting that `canUseTool` changed the text through `updatedInput` - Fixed `listSessions()` without a limit opening every transcript at once, which could leave sessions out when the open-file limit was reached - Changed `rewindFiles()` to refuse under a managed `fileCheckpointingEnabled: false`, and fixed it deleting files after a restore had failed - Changed `task_notification.output_file` to name a foreground subagent's output file, as it already does for background subagents - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.331
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
